thread:
zoe: quick sync on the API key modal mock — pushing a new frame to figma: https://www.figma.com/file/newframe (mobile + desktop)
peter: scanned it. love the one-row create. request: collapse 'permissions' into a small examples picker (like 'read-only', 'service', 'admin') instead of checkboxes. users choose a sample and can expand for advanced.
sam: +1. Also UX tiny: 'show secret' should be an explicit button with label and aria-pressed. current icon-only toggle is confusing on keyboard.
claire: copy suggestion for post-create toast: "API key created — copy the secret now. This secret will not be shown again." put a small 'download .env' link after the CTA.
zoe: agree on toast. also propose a 'one-click test' after rotate where we run a sample request (pre-populated curl) and show success/failure inline so users can verify before decommissioning old key.
peter: for bulk revoke empty state — current screen just says 'No results' which is unhelpful. propose: "No API keys match this filter. Try clearing filters or create a key. Learn about key scopes." (link subtle).
sam: accessibility note from keyboard pass: focus order must be name -> permissions picker -> expiration -> create. After copying secret set focus to snackbar with role="status" and message 'Secret copied'. That will announce on screenreaders.
claire: color/contrast nit on warning pill: small caption is <4.5:1. either darken text or use a solid icon with a lighter background. a11y-bot, can you run contrast?
a11y-bot: Automated scan: warning pill bg #FFD9A6, text #5A3A00 -> contrast 3.6:1. Recommendation: use bg #FFCC80 or text #331A00 for 4.5:1. Also ensure interactive elements have 48x48 touch target on mobile.
sam: UX microcopy: use sentence case in footers and helper text. e.g., 'Key expires in 90 days' not all caps.
zoe: mobile layout — collapse 'last used' and 'created' into a single subtitle line under the key name; actions go into kebab. Avoid horizontal scroll.
peter: permission tooltips idea: on hover/focus show one-line example like 'embeddings: create vector for search' to reduce cognitive load. Keep it optional.
claire: flow for rotate button label: prefer 'Rotate key' vs 'Regenerate' to match docs. small but reduces mismatch.
sam: security thought: when creating a key, show a short indicator if the selected sample permission allows model-generation to warn about billing risk. maybe a small :warning: with 'Can create generations'.
zoe: I'll update the figma with the compact examples picker and the test-new-key CTA. tagging @sam for a11y acceptance criteria and @claire for copy tweaks.
peter: thanks — will add a tiny helper that auto-fills curl snippet and a 'copy' button. :thumbsup:
claire: LGTM, will push wording changes to the PR description.
